title: Derived affine exchange before target-map reassociation
statement: Let R,A,B,D be commutative rings with the affine square and tensor coefficient map as in the ordinary source comparison [lem-pc-affine-tilde-tensor-source-comparison]. Assume the coefficient map sends b tensor q to psi(b) tensor q, but impose no invertibility of the derived pullback counit. The localized source followed by homotopy exchange [lem-pc-derived-base-change-unit-compatibility] and the right-derived pushforward unit equals the expanded coefficient map and affine pushforward comparison [lem-pc-affine-tilde-pushforward-cohomology-normalization], followed by the direct image of the localized inverse tensor/tilde complex comparison [def-pc-affine-base-change-tilde-representative-iso].

source.place: ordinary adjoint of exchange and derived-unit naturality

proof.text: The ordinary chain equality is proved in lem-pc-affine-tilde-tensor-ordinary-exchange-prenormalization-chain. The homotopy comparison is the quotient of that chain map: both composition identifications at a quotient complex are identities. Apply derived localization, which preserves composition, and then naturality of the right-derived pushforward unit to the inverse tensor/tilde comparison. This gives the stated equality with no assumption on the derived pullback counit.

proof_origin.place: derived ordinary exchange before final functorial reassociation
proof_origin.note: Intermediate derived transport without an invertible pullback-counit hypothesis; representative cancellation is proved separately in the parent.
